uCIFI_data_bridge.label: uCIFI data bridge
uCIFI_data_bridge.description: The uCIFI data bridge object may be used to transport data from a 3rd party device, operating a proprietary network or protocol, over a LwM2M compliant network.

Payload.label: Payload
Payload.description: Content of the message that is to be transported.

Hash.label: Hash
Hash.description: Hash to check the consistency of the data payload. Hash mechanism and calculation is vendor-specific.

Cumulated_daily_data_volume_up.label: Cumulated daily data volume up
Cumulated_daily_data_volume_up.description: Cumulated volume of data received by the device since beginning of the day. This information could be used for data invoicing.

Cumulated_daily_data_volume_down.label: Cumulated daily data volume down
Cumulated_daily_data_volume_down.description: Cumulated volume of data sent by the device since beginning of the day. This information could be used for data invoicing.

Cumulated_daily_data_volume_total.label: Cumulated daily data volume total
Cumulated_daily_data_volume_total.description: Cumulated volume of data sent and received by/from the device since beginning of the day. This information could be used for data invoicing.

Communication_error.label: Communication error
Communication_error.description: Set to True if the device detects a difference in a received payload and the hash.
